target_media_conditional: TEXT only if previous live published media is IMAGE and real receipt verified
post_text:
문화예술 기획·운영에 관심 있다면!
경기문화재단 일반직 6급 문화행정직 정규직 1명을 모집해요.

학력·경력 제한은 없지만 임용예정일 기준 만 60세 미만, 재단 결격사유에 해당하지 않아야 해요.
문화예술사업을 기획·운영하며 필기는 NCS 50문항, 행정학·예술경영 각 20문항이에요.

학예연구직(장애인 제한경쟁) 1명과 별도 모집이며, 직종 간 중복지원은 불가해요.
11월 23일 17:00까지 온라인 접수예요.

자세한 사항은 프로필링크 확인

official_sources.notice_title: 2026년 경기문화재단 제5회 직원 채용(일반직 및 운영직)
official_sources.direct_source_read: Original employer PDF full text read using original employer download endpoint; pages 1, 2, 5 independently visually verified; relevant tables, restrictions, exam and online application reviewed

qualifications.mandatory_common: 학력·경력 제한 없음; 임용예정일 기준 만 60세 미만; 재단 취업규정 제41조 결격사유에 해당하지 않아야 함
qualifications.mandatory_unit_specific: 문화행정직 추가 자격증 제한 표기 없음
qualifications.preferred: 취업지원대상자 법정 가점 적용시 증빙 및 모집단위별 법령 요건 확인
qualifications.test: NCS 50문항 + 행정학 20문항 + 예술경영 20문항; 인적성검사 미응시 시 불합격; 필기 후 서류심사·면접

evidence_crosschecks: Employer PDF p1 total 8 split 2 regular general (two different units) + 6 operating; selected unit 1 not total 8
Employer PDF p2 age measured on appointment date; no education/career restrictions
Employer PDF sections 3-4 NCS+two subjects and selection procedure
Employer PDF p5 states 11/23 17:00 online deadline and official recruitment URL
Employer job description separate PDF text inspected
Employer public listing labels posting 진행 as of review, but Incruit job page labels it 대기중 despite application dates; live application control unresolved
excluded_claims: Never treat original source hash from collector as semantic validation
Raw PDF bytes/SHA unavailable in current execution; do not invent
No claim of application submission eligibility or full correction/cancellation check
pre_cas_recheck: Fetch official PDF and job description source again inside 24h window, obtain raw bytes+SHA and verify content semantics
Verify corrections/cancellation and active application form on official Incruit site, reconcile state difference
Verify approved v5 post, exact single-body and CTA, media alternation and any card pixels
Verify not already queued/posted and CAS ref/claim/day 4 posts; run validate_entry+official_receipt checks
Only then reviewed-submissions -> ingest -> queue_bridge; never retroactively set source freshness or republish past post
